findings.bounded_blocker: Previously documented atomic decomposition/capability classification and field/condition/relationship attachment failures remain systematic across multiple required strata; no separate novel root-cause class was established from aggregate-only evidence.
fixed_or_acceptable: All ten human-sample source spans matched their pinned capture and source-slice checksums.
All ten required coverage strata were represented by the seven protected witnesses.
The 38-test C2 development/regression suite passed; legal-kit completeness and full-catalog parse coverage remained 367/367.
Two source-anchored effect occurrences matched exactly under the atomic occurrence matcher.
isolated_unsupported_taxonomy_or_source_: The three supplemental known-regression sample records had passing source identity/selection but remained entirely unknown_non_authoritative in the fidelity-checked arm; they were not treated as held-out semantic evidence.
All 15 protected C1.1 fidelity dimensions were unknown for all seven witnesses, so R5 could not score those dimensions from the current owner-oracle contract.

Approved unsupported semantics remain outside the admitted taxonomy, including the Stellar Burst dependency and the Fire-damage aura activation dependency; they remain explicit gaps rather than being mapped to unrelated values.
systematic_semantic_failures: Across the protected cohort, all three arms had zero dependency true positives and zero capability-label true positives; the structural/fidelity-checked arms had 24 effect false positives against 15 expected effects.

Condition accuracy was 0/10 and relationship accuracy 0/1; recipient, magnitude, result, target-cardinality, trigger, and state-reference field accuracy also remained low or zero across multiple strata.

mechanic graph and parent/child relationship loss

paired_comparison.reason: Post-remediation false positives increased across the structural and fidelity-checked arms while capability and dependency true positives remained zero; the small effect-occurrence recall increase does not meet the predeclared meaningful-precision requirement.
